attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools (T1562.001)
attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to disable the Safe Attachment policy to evade detection.
description: A user disabled an Exchange Safe Attachment policy, which provides phishing protection to email attachments.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection, Email
investigative_actions: Follow further actions done by the account. Verify that the configuration change was expected. Check for a possible phishing campaign on the organization.
name: Exchange Safe Attachment policy disabled or removed
